name: ElevenLabs Agents
positioning: A conversational agent platform from a speech-model company, deploying voice and chat agents across phone, web, WhatsApp, SMS and email on top of its own text-to-speech and speech-to-text models.

pricing.model: Subscription tiers that include a monthly allotment of call minutes, with additional minutes billed per minute; LLM usage is billed on top; telephony from your own provider billed by that provider.
pricing.headline: $0.08 per call minute beyond the minutes included in each plan, plus LLM usage at provider cost; plans run from Free ($0, 15 minutes) to Business ($990 per month, 12,375 minutes).
planNotes: Free: 15 minutes, 4 concurrent calls. Starter $6/month: 75 minutes, 6 concurrent. Creator $22/month: 275 minutes, 10 concurrent. Pro $99/month: 1,238 minutes, 20 concurrent. Scale $299/month: 3,738 minutes, 30 concurrent. Business $990/month: 12,375 minutes, 40 concurrent. Enterprise: custom.
Additional minutes $0.08 per minute on every plan; text messages $0.003 each.
Burst pricing: calls above the concurrency limit (up to 3x, max 300 for non-enterprise) are charged at 2x ($0.16 per minute).
Voice calls without text get a 95% discount for silence longer than 10 seconds (help center).
Startup Grants Program offers 12 months free for qualifying startups (vendor page).
pricing.freeTrial: Free plan with 15 minutes of calls included, no card stated.
whatIsExtra: LLM usage, passed through at cost based on the model chosen
Telephony: no ElevenLabs telephony fee, but an external provider such as Twilio or a SIP trunk bills you directly

strengths.claim: Large voice catalog from its own models: 17,000+ voices across 90+ languages, plus voice cloning and expressive voice models.
Multichannel agents with shared context across phone, web, WhatsApp, SMS and email, plus workflows, guardrails, simulations and analytics.

Strong enterprise and compliance posture on the vendor's pages: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, PCI DSS Level 1, HIPAA-eligible with BAAs, regional data residency (US, EU, India), zero-retention mode and on-prem options.
Wide telephony and contact-center connectivity: native Twilio, SIP trunking, Telnyx, Plivo, Vonage, Genesys, Five9, Amazon Connect and Microsoft Teams guides.
Developer-friendly: LLM-agnostic with bring-your-own model, native web and mobile SDKs, WebSocket and REST APIs.

limitations.claim: LLM costs are billed separately from the $0.08 per minute call rate, based on the chosen model.
Calls above the concurrency limit are billed at double the rate, and burst concurrency is capped at 300 calls for non-enterprise customers.
HIPAA use requires a signed BAA and Zero Retention Mode, and BAAs are listed as an Enterprise plan feature.

compliance.note: Stated by vendor, self-attested: the agents page lists SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, PCI DSS Level 1 and HIPAA compliant; docs say ElevenAgents is HIPAA-eligible with BAAs for eligible customers when Zero Retention Mode is on. GDPR is not named on the pages read, though regional data residency (US, EU, India) is described.

telephony.providedNumbers: Not stated on the pages read; docs describe connecting your own numbers through Twilio, SIP trunking and other providers.

stepsToLeave: Read agent configuration (prompt, first message, voice, tools) with the Get agent / List agents API using your API key.
Read knowledge base documents with the knowledge base list and get-content API endpoints.
Export batch call results with the batch calling export API.
Numbers connected through Twilio or a SIP trunk stay with your carrier and can be repointed.
Recreate prompts, tools and knowledge in the new platform and test before cutover.

bestFor: Teams that prioritise voice quality, language breadth and multichannel agents, and are comfortable with a subscription-plus-usage pricing model.

sources.title: ElevenLabs help: How much does ElevenAgents cost

unknowns: The $0.08 per minute rate and plan minutes come from the pricing page; the help-center page confirms billing structure but not the number, and the burst doc confirms the 2x multiple (so the base figure is effectively single-source).
Whether ElevenLabs sells phone numbers directly was not found.
Typical LLM cost per minute depends on model and is shown inside the product.
GDPR statement not found on the pages read.
Pricing page carries a promotional first-month discount until Oct 18 and 3x credits until Oct 12 (creative plans), which may change.
